_readme: SUPERSEDED by winning-hooks.md, which is the complete, intentional set
of hooks -- only those, all of equal weight, matched by reading the file
and changing as few words as possible. Nothing is to be added here. These
thirty-eight remain only because hookgen.py's scorer needs the structured
fields below, and the prose swipe file has none of them.
en      the hook exactly as it was supplied, in English.
sv      an idiomatic Swedish rendering -- grammar, not word-for-word.
tags    what the hook is ABOUT. Scored against the project's topic.
slots   the one phrase in the hook that may be swapped for the project's
own subject. 'words' is how many English words that costs, which
is what the <=3 rule counts. A hook with no slot is offered
verbatim -- zero words changed, which is the preferred outcome.
entities  named things the hook is stuck with. If the video is not about
them the hook is penalised, because it cannot be fixed by a swap.
